summary: Wrote a 5-phase implementation plan for the two red typst lint suites, implementing the research report's rulings rather than re-deciding them. Item A drops the single 2>&1 call site in chapter-quality-check.sh's check_placement() so stderr inherits fd 2 (observable, not discarded); Item B applies resolution (iii) at the fixture layer only, amending case-h2 to carry one theorem-family element and adding the suite's first positive coverage of check 4's presence warning. Later phases fold in in-scope shellcheck cleanup, delete both known-failures.txt rows this task owns (fix-track, not formal acceptance), and redeploy with a full gate run. Waves: [1,2] then [3] then [4] then [5].

artifacts.summary: 5-phase plan: channel separation in check_placement(), fixture-layer Item B ruling plus new presence coverage, shellcheck cleanup, known-failures row deletion, redeploy and full gate.
